record_type_quote: Experiment 2 , which was run in Chicago by M. Berniker and K. Kording, reproduced the study by  Shadmehr and Mussa-Ivaldi (1994)  along with two variations on the original protocol.

targets.title: Adaptive representation of dynamics during learning of a motor task.
targets.evidence_quote: The first experiment was designed to test between three possible accounts of the original findings of  Shadmehr and Mussa-Ivaldi (1994) .
targets.outcome_quote: One puzzling aspect of our results is the failure of  experiment 2  to replicate the original results of  Shadmehr and Mussa-Ivaldi (1994) . We attempted to match the adaptation and generalization protocols of the two experiments. Whereas our subjects demonstrated clear evidence of adaptation, not unlike the original study, we see dramatic differences in the generalization patterns between the two studies.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Both experiments fail to support the central intrinsic-coordinate generalization finding. Successful adaptation is a preliminary feature, not the central finding challenged.

reasoning: New participants perform two experiments re-testing the original coordinate representation claim. Other studies are discussed as background comparisons rather than directly re-tested targets. Title and all authors verified from article XML.
